contract: Whether Cal.com's own branding is suppressed for a booking is a single derived property of the booking's event type, and it must be resolved through the canonical org-aware resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts (team -> team.parent organization, or owner -> owner.profile.organization, per resolveHideBranding at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45). Every consumer of that property - the booking page, the confirmation page, and equally every workflow/automation that emits an outgoing message - must derive it the same way and therefore agree. Reading the raw `hideBranding` column off one entity (the event type's individual owner, or a team without its parent) instead of calling the resolver breaks the contract, because it silently drops the organization-level setting and makes the value an automation sends with diverge from the value the booker is shown.

defect_location.summary: The booking-page side obeys the contract: apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199 and apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299 call shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent / shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent, which route through resolveHideBranding (packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45, 85-110) and return true whenever team.parent.hideBranding or owner.profile.organization.hideBranding is set. Every automation entry point instead reads the raw column off the event type's individual owner and passes that literal boolean into the workflow scheduler: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618, :2793 and :2808 (`hideBranding: !!eventType.owner?.hideBranding`), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459 and :472 (fed by the owner-only selects at :245-247, :309-313, :359-363), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112 (whose type at :30-35 admits owner.hideBranding and team.parentId but never team.hideBranding or the parent's), packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188. For an organization that sets hideBranding at the org level (or any team event, where eventType.owner is null) this evaluates to false while the booking page evaluates to true. That false value is plumbed unchanged through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:145,:169, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,:97,:161,:213,:248,:262-280 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18-38,:82 into packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,:115,:147,:182 where it is handed to the renderer at :199-205 (`customTemplate(..., hideBranding)`), so the Cal.com name and logo are printed in the attendee's message. Two further sites resolve the same flag from their own wrong place: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, :274-276 and :433-435 pick `eventType.team.hideBranding` or `booking.user.hideBranding` with no parent-organization fallback at all, backed by the select in packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:40,:170,:201 which fetches team.parentId but not the parent's hideBranding; and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 resolves via getHideBranding keyed on the WORKFLOW's owner (workflow.userId / workflow.teamId) rather than on the booking's event type, so a workflow owned by a different entity than the booked event type again disagrees with the booking page. The org-aware data the correct resolver needs is fetched by packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-469 and packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1332, and the shared event-type select at packages/prisma/selects/event-types.ts:117-127 currently exposes only owner.hideBranding.
